messages.text: So, based on this results - which layout would you propose ?

I would carry forward the **mild layout** as the preferred candidate:

| Component | Proposed placement |
|---|---|
| Pixel barrel radii | **32, 60, 106, 182 mm** |
| Pixel barrel staves | Unchanged: **12, 22, 18, 30** |
| Pixel endcaps, each side | Keep the existing nine disks; add one at **\|z\| = 900 mm** |
| Short and long strips | Keep the reference layout |
| Added disk material | Homogeneous donor-disk-2 material behind the sensors |

It gives the strongest compromise under your **geometric-primary** choice: d0 core widths improve **2.4–5.1%**, z0 **3.7–6.5%**, and ten-hit coverage reaches **96.5–96.8%**, while preserving the existing outer lever arms.

The balanced layout gains another roughly 1.5 percentage points of coverage, but its primary 1 GeV momentum regression makes it less attractive.

**I would keep mild provisional.** Its Gaussian 1 GeV momentum width worsens by about 4%, and forward coverage holes remain. Candidate-specific material and response validation should resolve those points before adopting it as the baseline.
